name: Knife
description: A small utility blade; easy to conceal.

name: Dagger
description: A slim fighting knife, quick to draw and throw.

name: Wooden Club
description: A simple hardwood cudgel.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A sturdy wooden staff favored by travelers and mystics.

name: Hand Axe
description: A one-handed axe that doubles as a wood-cutter.

name: Mace
description: A flanged head on a short haft; punishes armor.

name: Hammer
description: A one-handed smith's hammer pressed into service.

name: Short Sword
description: A short, well-balanced blade.

name: Long Sword
description: A long blade wielded two-handed for reach and power.

name: Battle Axe
description: A heavy two-handed axe.

name: War Hammer
description: A massive two-handed hammer.

name: War Staff
description: An iron-shod staff swung with both hands.

name: Short Bow
description: A light bow for hunting and skirmishing.

name: Crossbow
description: A crank-drawn bow; slow to load but hard-hitting.

name: Arrows (quiver of 20)
effect: Ammunition for a bow.
description: A quiver of fletched arrows.

name: Crossbow Bolts (case of 20)
effect: Ammunition for a crossbow.
description: A case of iron-headed bolts.

name: Tunic
description: Everyday clothing; offers no real protection.

name: Leather Armor
description: Boiled leather; light and quiet (Light armor).

name: Chain Mail
description: Interlinked steel rings (Mail armor).

name: Plate Armor
description: Full articulated plate; the best protection there is.

name: Buckler
description: A small shield strapped to the forearm.

name: Wooden Shield
description: A round wooden shield.

name: Steel Shield
description: A banded steel shield; heavier but durable.

name: Leather Cap
description: A padded cap. Optional gear: +1 Defense.

name: Full Helm
description: An enclosed steel helm. Optional gear: +1 Defense, but -1 to Wits checks that rely on sight or hearing.

name: Potion of Healing
effect: Restores 1d8 Life when drunk.
description: A warm red draught that knits wounds closed.

name: Potion of Hover
effect: Drift and hover just above the ground for one scene.
description: A shimmering blue elixir, lighter than it looks.

name: Potion of Strength
effect: +2 Might for one scene.
description: A thick green tonic that swells the thews.

name: Potion of Vigor
effect: Clears all Strain and shrugs off fatigue.
description: A bright amber cordial that sharpens the senses.

name: Sunstone
effect: Sheds warm light on command; grant +1 to one fire spell, then it dims.
description: A cut amber crystal that holds captured sunlight.

name: Mindshard
effect: Steadies the mind: +1 to one spellcasting check, then goes dull.
description: A faceted amethyst that hums against the thoughts.

name: Heartstone
effect: Mends its bearer slowly: restore 1 Life at each rest.
description: A green crystal warm as a beating heart.

name: Charmstone
effect: +1 to one Persuasion or social check, then it cracks.
description: A rose-pink crystal that makes its holder easy to like.

name: Frostshard
effect: Radiates cold; grant +1 to one frost or water spell, then it clouds over.
description: A star-sapphire shard rimed with everlasting frost.

name: Traveler's Cloak
effect: Keeps out cold and rain on the road.
description: A heavy brown wool cloak.

name: Forester's Cloak
effect: +1 to Stealth checks to hide in the wild.
description: A mottled green cloak that blends into the woods.

name: Noble's Cloak
effect: +1 to social checks among the highborn.
description: A fine embroidered cloak fit for a court.

name: Amulet of Warding
effect: Once per day, add +1 Defense against a magical attack.
description: A blue-stoned amulet that turns aside hostile magic.

name: Gold Ring
description: A fine gold band; a keepsake, signet, or ready coin.

name: Silver Ring
description: A plain silver ring of modest worth.

name: Gold Bracelet
description: A heavy gold bracelet.

name: Azure Bracelet
description: Silver set with blue stones.

name: Garnet Bracelet
description: Bronze set with red garnets.

name: Torch
effect: Burns about an hour, lighting the way.
description: A pitch-soaked brand.

name: Oil Lamp
effect: Casts steady light while its oil lasts.
description: A brass lamp with a glass chimney.

name: Rope (25 ft)
effect: Strong hemp rope, 25 feet.
description: A coil of sturdy hemp rope.

name: Waterskin
effect: Holds a day's water.
description: A leather flask for water or wine.

name: Trail Rations (1 week)
effect: Preserved food for one week.
description: Dried meat, hardtack, and nuts.

name: Adventurer's Pack
effect: A ready kit for the road.
description: A backpack with bedroll, flint, sack, and sundries.

name: Healer's Kit
effect: +1 to Healing checks; stabilizes a Down ally.
description: Bandages, needle, and salves in a roll.

name: Healing Herbs
effect: Brewed or applied, restore 1d4 Life once.
description: A bundle of dried medicinal herbs.

name: Spell Scroll
effect: Reads out one stored spell (the Guide sets it), then crumbles to ash.
description: A rolled vellum scribed with a single spell.

name: Tome of Lore
effect: +1 to a Lore check on the subject it covers.
description: A weighty book of collected knowledge.

name: Old Map
effect: Marks a place of interest; its worth depends on where it leads.
description: A brittle old map of forgotten roads.

name: Sealed Letter
effect: A message under seal - a quest, clue, or summons.
description: A folded letter closed with wax.

name: Iron Key
effect: Opens one specific lock.
description: A heavy iron key, worn smooth.

name: Ring of Keys
effect: A jailer's or steward's keys.
description: An iron ring heavy with keys.
